criteria.requirement: Add keyword-only on_error="flush"|"discard" to actual ChunkedInsert/ChunkedUpdate and validate positive non-bool chunksize. Default flush preserves existing behavior. In discard mode normal exit still flushes, while an application exception clears only the pending queue (and pending insert field set), invokes no callback/write and preserves the original exception; already committed chunks remain. Empty flush is an idempotent no-op. Preserve callback/write failures as failures and explicit outer Database transaction rollback behavior. Demonstrate real SQLite insert/update, pending state reuse and full-chunk vs tail distinction; never claim discard undoes committed chunks.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
